name: selecta
description: Background music for your coding sessions, in the terminal. Every repository builds its own soundtrack.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube Data API key (optional)
youtube_api_key.description: Enables playing specific songs by name. Free: console.cloud.google.com -> new project -> enable YouTube Data API v3 -> Credentials -> API key. Leave blank and radio still works with no account.

jamendo_client_id.title: Jamendo client ID (optional)
jamendo_client_id.description: Free key from https://devportal.jamendo.com that enables text search over Creative Commons tracks. Leave blank: SomaFM and radio-browser need no key.
